scope: CREATE TABLE public.client_* declarations in product-experience SQL migrations
policyDecision: All tenant data and files: per-item active retention up to 28 days, followed by 7 recovery-only days; purge at active expiry plus 7 days

classes.remainingGate: Runtime records now have local age-filtered member reads/writes/deletes, server-dated inserts, immutable creation timestamps, and export-time active-window filtering. Privileged search and graph refresh filter to active retention; graph-node/edge RLS immediately hides expired-derived documents, tags, URLs, and relationships. Synthetic SQL and route tests cover active expiry and the seven-day recovery delay. Runtime jobs, Agent Room records, Visual-QA reports/findings, Pipeline items, Board/Loop/Paperclip/Hermes and Ruflo content, notebook containers, structured research rows, runtime requests/actions, and tenant-linked support requests have local age barriers or bounded purge paths with synthetic SQL coverage; request/Visual-QA/Board/Loop/Paperclip/Hermes/Ruflo cleanup is child-first, and younger child rows retain their own expiry while delaying parent purge. Room conversations now use fixed original deadlines, with messages, rounds, copied job payloads and approved directives bounded by the source window; no activity renewal or younger-child extension is accepted. Recovery-only rows are excluded from member reads and ordinary restore; bounded purge and foreign-cascade prevention have local SQL coverage. Pipeline deletion uses non-cascading artifact/job references. Paperclip company settings have a local 28-day age barrier, seven-day recovery delay, tenant-scoped bounded purge, and synthetic SQL coverage. Unlinked public inquiries are outside tenant cleanup. Notebook expiry detaches, not deletes, active child content. User-downloaded export copies, offboarding backups, vendor copies, hosted migrations, and scheduled operation remain unverified. The coverage list identifies current local paths, not proof of complete hosted enforcement.

Define lifecycle for active tenant configuration, memberships, provider references, onboarding identity, and provisioning metadata; expire credentials/tokens promptly; preserve only the minimum authorization evidence needed for operation or dispute handling.

Onboarding tokens are unusable at expires_at and both token hashes and runtime rate-limit hashes have local, bounded service-role purges after seven-day recovery windows. Runtime limiter rows store their active duration, capped at one hour. Verify deployment and scheduled operation of both purges before treating this class as covered.
